profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced and knowledgeable Software Engineer with a work history in the field of  data and software. Not tied to one language but skilled in Java/Spring boot, Python, Javascript/React and SAS/Base. Background in engineering profession with a Bachelor of Science focused in Computer Science from Queens College and in the process of obtaining a Master's degree in Computer Science at Stevens Institute of Technology.

positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Agile Methodologies · Back-End Web Development · Bitbucket · Data Analysis · Data Structures · Databases · Git · Java · JavaScript · Microservices · Node.js · PostgreSQL · Problem Solving · Programming · Python (Programming Language) · REST API · SQL · Software Development · Spring Boot · Teamwork

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Problem Solving · Data Analysis · Software Development · Spring Boot · Java · Bitbucket · Teamwork · JavaScript · Databases · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Programming · REST API · PostgreSQL · Back-End Web Development · JSON · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Primary technology used: Java 8, Spring Boot, Groovy, Spock Testing Framework, JSON, YAML
•	A part of a small team of 7 developing Account Opening Experience platform creating a generic/customizable experience based on a product team’s configuration file
•	Developed REST API services in Java/Spring Boot following the microservice architecture to consume and transfer JSON formatted data 
     o	Most microservices would communicate with common microservices that would communicate with certain database/data storage system
•	Wrote unit/layer test cases in Spock to test functionality of each REST API and made sure code coverage meet at least 90% 
•	Deployed microservice’s Docker images on Oracle Container Platform
•	Provided help to support tickets raised by other teams
•	Contract renews every 6 to 8 months

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Primary technology used: SAS, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office
•	Programmed scripts in SAS to run on delivered datasets that summarized and identified data variations
•	Reviewed the different variations and developed scripts to maintain a coherent format. Followed HIPAA compliance to remove any sensitive data
•	Analyzed the data to create a flow each trial and try to match the clinics documents
•	Organized and maintained cloned datasets to build a single master dataset

positions.title: Research and Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Administered and reviewed students’ assignments and exams
•	Researched “The Planned Behavior” model and special topics around it to create an experimental model
•	Tested experimental model to see if it was able to change behavior by asking key questions

honors.title: AT&T Hackathon Winner
honors.description: During a 24 hours hackathon held by AT&T,  we created an Android application that scans and reads physical coupons using Google Vision and showed results on Google Maps. We won third place.

projects.title: Coupon Me
projects.description: During a 24 hours hackathon held by AT&T,  we created an Android application that scans and reads physical coupons using Google Vision to show nearby locations that carries the product on Google Maps. In the project, I assisted in building the Android application by researching how to add Google Vision and how to process the information collected by the scan.

projects.title: Portfolio/Personal Website
projects.description: Using what I have learned during two web programming courses, I wanted to practice by creating and designing a responsive website using Express, Handlebars, Bootstrap/custom CSS and JavaScript to showcase academic projects
